contexts.statement: OpenAI Math Audit #321: Counterexample to Wall's Finite D(2) Problem
Representation-sensitive obstructions to finite two-dimensional homotopy models, over arbitrary fields and finite-dimensional right local systems.

definitions.locally_indicable: Every nontrivial finitely generated subgroup admits an epimorphism onto Z.
definitions.scalar_blindness: Every rank-one character is trivial on the image of every finite source with zero first rational Betti number.

contexts.statement: Exact relation-gap consequences for the accepted original and scalar-blind extended Wall D(2) constructions, with n=5 and n=6.

definitions.F_n: Free group on x1,a1,x2,a2,s, and additionally t when n=6.
definitions.N_n: Normal closure of r1=x1*a1*x1^-1*a1^-4, r2=x2*a2*x2^-1*a2^-3, r3=x1*a2^-13, r4=s*x2*s^-1*a1^-5, and additionally r5=t*s*t^-1*x1^-1*s^-1 when n=6.
definitions.P_n: F_n/N_n; t1=x1^2; t2=x2^3; w=t1*t2; K_n=normal closure of t1,t2 in P_n; G_n=P_n/K_n; R_n=ker(F_n->G_n).
definitions.d_F(R): Minimum number of elements whose F-normal closure is R.
definitions.d_ZG(M): Minimum number of left ZG-module generators, not a module-rank assertion.
definitions.Def(G): Maximum of p-q over all finite p-generator q-relator presentations of G.

contexts.statement: Universal torsion obstruction for the evaluated Fox boundary of an arbitrary finite presentation.

definitions.presentation: n,m are arbitrary natural numbers; r:Fin m->FreeGroup(Fin n); G=FreeGroup(Fin n)/normalClosure(range r).
definitions.character: rho:G->Complex units is an arbitrary group homomorphism, with no finite-image assumption.
definitions.Fox: The unique source-word crossed derivative with d(x_i)=e_i, d(uv)=d(u)+rho(u)d(v); D_rho sends the jth basis vector to d(r_j).
definitions.torsion: q is a positive natural number and g^q=1; q need not be the exact order.

claims.natural_statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 321 ('A Counterexample to Wall's D(2) Problem', unformalized in Lean), which claims to construct a finite connected 3D CW complex satisfying Wall's D(2) cohomological finiteness condition that is not homotopy equivalent to any finite 2-complex: either (a) discover and certify a group-presentation, chain-complex, Quillen plus-construction, or homotopy/Euler-characteristic obstruction flaw in sections/02-tower.tex, sections/03-plus.tex, or sections/04-construction.tex with an exact algebraic certificate, or (b) independently verify and certify the algebraic and cohomological construction with a deterministic certificate.
Mannan's Section 2 establishes the finite-plus input for a perfect subgroup finitely normally generated in the ambient group; this prior theorem alone does not establish perfectness of the present K.
The maximal cyclic-tower method is prior work, but its existence theorem alone does not establish preservation of the present twisted H_2 under a cyclic cover.
Mannan's Section 2 establishes the finite-plus input for a perfect subgroup finitely normally generated in the ambient group; this prior theorem alone does not establish perfectness of the present K.

external_assumptions.statement: For a finite connected two-complex and a perfect normal subgroup finitely normally generated in its fundamental group, the plus construction can be performed by finitely many two- and three-cells and has cohomological dimension at most two.
external_assumptions.source: Mannan, Quillen's plus construction and the D(2) problem (2009); prior finding supplied by the mission, primary-source applicability still to be checked.

claims.natural_statement: The maximal cyclic-tower method is prior work, but its existence theorem alone does not establish preservation of the present twisted H_2 under a cyclic cover.

external_assumptions.statement: The literature constructs maximal cyclic tower lifts of maps from compact domains. This by itself says nothing about the particular twisted homology used here.
external_assumptions.source: Howie (1981), On pairs of 2-complexes and systems of equations over groups; Louder-Wilton, Stackings and the W-cycles conjecture, Section 3. Exact primary-source version and hypotheses have not yet been obtained; not used in place of the independent proof.

claims.natural_statement: Ordinary cellular homology with a finite-rank local system uses direct sums of fibers, hence finite-support chains, also on an infinite cover.
For a subcomplex A of a complex T of dimension at most two, H_2(A;L|A) injects into H_2(T;L), without a fundamental-group injectivity hypothesis.
On a connected complex H_0 with local coefficients is the fiber's coinvariant space; in rank one a nontrivial character makes it zero.

The canonical deck action on a pulled-back local system is identity on the downstairs fiber and commutes with parallel transport; cellular chains of an infinite cyclic cover of a finite complex are finite free k[z,z^-1]-modules.
Coinvariants for the canonical deck action identify the upstairs chain complex at z=1 with the downstairs local-coefficient chain complex; no character value is lost.
A matrix over k[z,z^-1] with injective specialization at z=1 is injective over k[z,z^-1], including the zero-column case.
For every finite connected complex A of dimension at most two, rank-one complex local system L, and connected infinite cyclic cover p, H_2(A;L)=0 implies H_2(Ahat;p*L)=0.
A finite CW complex of dimension at most two has a finite simplicial homotopy model of dimension at most two, so the given map can be made simplicial after one fixed subdivision of its finite domain.
If b_1(F;Q)=0 and F is finite and connected, every composite pi_1(F)->pi_1(A)->Z is zero; a simplicial map F->A lifts simplicially to that cyclic cover without subdividing F again.
An image lift through a connected nontrivial cover has strictly more simplices than its downstairs image, unless the cover has a section; the simplex count never exceeds the fixed domain's count.
Every simplicial map from finite connected F with b_1(F;Q)=0 has a cyclic-tower image A of maximal simplex count, and that A has b_1(A;Q)=0.
A finite connected two-dimensional complex with nontrivial rank-one monodromy and zero twisted H_2 has chi<=0, hence b_1(-;Q)>=1.
For finite connected Y of dimension at most two and rank-one complex L with H_2(Y;L)=0, every map F->Y from finite connected simplicial F with b_1(F;Q)=0 pulls L back to trivial monodromy.
Under the tower theorem's hypotheses every finite-order element of pi_1(Y) lies in the kernel of the character.
After killing a finitely normally generated perfect K by two-cells, the preimage Bbar in the universal cover is connected, has fundamental group K, and has H_1(Bbar;Z)=0.
For R=ZG the relative complex of the new two-cells is R^r[2], and H_2(Bprime-tilde;Z) surjects R-linearly onto R^r.
Degree-two Hurewicz representatives of lifts of the r relative basis vectors give r three-cell attachments with q*d_3=id_R^r.

The split injection d_3 and the degreewise split contractible relative complex imply universal-cover H_i=0 for i>2, H^3(X;M)=0 for every left R-module, and homology preservation for every right R-module without flatness or finite generation.

A finite connected two-dimensional B and a perfect normal subgroup K normally generated by r elements admit the manuscript's finite plus construction using r two-cells and r three-cells, with all three stated properties.
In the stated presentation, t_1=a_2^26=[t_2,a_2] and s*t_2*s^-1=a_1^15=[t_1,a_1], with commutator [u,v]=uvu^-1v^-1.
In K_ab, with its genuine left ZG conjugation action, u_1=(1-a_2)u_2 and s*u_2=(1-a_1)u_1; norm sums give 26u_1=0 and 15u_2=0 without commuting distinct actions.
The normal closure of x_1^2 and x_2^3 in the manuscript's five-generator four-relator group P is perfect.
The assignments (x_1,a_1,x_2,a_2,s)=(-1,zeta,zeta^2,-1,1), zeta^2+zeta+1=0, respect every relator and kill both normal generators, defining a character of G=P/K.

Word-level evaluated Fox differentiation gives exactly the manuscript's four-by-five row boundary matrix over Q[zeta]/(zeta^2+zeta+1), and D*d_1=0 in the stated right-coefficient/left-chain convention.
The x_1,a_1,x_2,s column minor of the independently reconstructed Fox matrix is -4(1-zeta^2), is nonzero, and hence the twisted second boundary is injective.
The local system L_rho on the finite plus complex X has H_2(X;L_rho)=0.
G has an epimorphism to Z sending s to 1 and the other generators to 0; x_1 has order exactly two in G, detected by rho(x_1)=-1.

There exists a finite connected three-dimensional CW complex X with infinite fundamental group, H_i(Xtilde;Z)=0 for i>2 and H^3(X;M)=0 for every left Zpi_1(X)-module M, but no finite two-dimensional homotopy model.
The standalone exact verifier reconstructs the prescribed algebraic data from the relator words and rejects corrupted witnesses; it makes no claim to mechanically prove the universal topology.
The manuscript's actual cited theorem uses are compared against primary sources, distinguishing applicable statements, contextual references, and any unobtainable sources.

For any field k, finite connected CW complex Y of dimension at most two, and finite-rank k-local system V with H_2(Y;V)=0, every map F->Y from finite connected simplicial F with b_1(F;Q)=0 pulls V back to trivial monodromy.

The standard covering-space, CW homology, approximation, and Hurewicz results stated as assumptions apply to the complexes used here; in particular the sphere-representability step is applied to a simply connected universal cover and the lifting step to connected locally path-connected domains.
The maximal cyclic-tower method is prior work, but its existence theorem alone does not establish preservation of the present twisted H_2 under a cyclic cover.

claims.natural_statement: For a finitely generated subgroup H of pi_1(Y) with finite abelianization, there is a finite connected two-dimensional presentation complex F and map F->Y with fundamental-group image exactly H and H_1(F;Q)=H_2(F;Q)=0; finite presentability of H is unnecessary.

For finite connected Y of dimension at most two, any field k, and finite-dimensional right k-representation V of pi_1(Y), H_2(Y;V)=0 implies each finitely generated subgroup H either acts trivially on V or surjects onto Z. If the representation is faithful, pi_1(Y) is locally indicable.

The standard two-complex of BS(1,2), with its two-dimensional rational affine representation, has zero twisted H_2 but contains a detected subgroup isomorphic to Z[1/2], which admits no epimorphism onto Z; the subgroup theorem cannot omit finite generation.

Let K be the presentation complex <a,b | a^2 b^-3, a^2(b^-1 a)^-5> and X=K x S^1. Then X has integral homology of S^1, universal-cover homology zero above degree two, and H_2 zero for every rank-one local system over every field. Every scalar tower obstruction is satisfied. Nevertheless an explicit two-dimensional F5 local system is acyclic and detects the perfect subgroup pi_1(K), so X has no finite two-dimensional homotopy model. This is not asserted to be a D(2) example.

claims.natural_statement: After adjoining a generator t and relator t s t^-1 x_1^-1 s^-1 to the accepted presentation P, the normal closure Kprime of x_1^2,x_2^3 remains perfect: it is the normal closure of the image of the accepted perfect K. No injectivity of P into the enlarged group is required.

In the enlarged six-generator five-relator presentation, assign x_1=a_2=-I, a_1=zeta I, x_2=zeta^2 I, s=diag(zeta,-zeta), and t the swap matrix, where char(k) is not 2 and zeta has order three. These matrices kill x_1^2,x_2^3. The ten-by-twelve evaluated Fox boundary has a ten-by-ten minor 16(1-zeta^2)^3, nonzero; over F7 with zeta=2 its value is 2.

For the enlarged plus complex Xprime, pi_1(Xprime)_ab is C3 plus Z^2. Let S(Z) mean that, over every field, every rank-one character with H_2(Z;k_chi)=0 pulls back trivially along every map from a finite connected source with zero first rational Betti number. Among finite D(2) complexes, S_fin is strictly stronger than S: the accepted Xdagger satisfies S but its t-parity double cover fails S over C. Both are finite D(2) complexes, and any finite two-dimensional homotopy model implies S_fin.

The certified chain retraction persists under tensoring with every right Z[G]-module, and qD3=id gives H3 cohomology vanishing for every left Z[G]-module without flatness or finiteness hypotheses.

This is universal noncommutative algebra, not a scalar specialization or a formalization of the topological Hurewicz and tower arguments.
claims.formal_statement:
import Mathlib

open scoped BigOperators

noncomputable section

namespace IntegralPlus

abbrev Free := FreeGroup (Fin 5)

def X : Free := FreeGroup.of 0
def A : Free := FreeGroup.of 1
def Y : Free := FreeGroup.of 2
def B : Free := FreeGroup.of 3
def S : Free := FreeGroup.of 4

def r1 : Free := X * A * X⁻¹ * (A ^ 4)⁻¹
def r2 : Free := Y * B * Y⁻¹ * (B ^ 3)⁻¹
def r3 : Free := X * (B ^ 13)⁻¹
def r4 : Free := S * Y * S⁻¹ * (A ^ 5)⁻¹
def t1 : Free := X ^ 2
def t2 : Free := Y ^ 3
def rels : Set Free := {r1, r2, r3, r4, t1, t2}

abbrev G := PresentedGroup rels
abbrev R := MonoidAlgebra ℤ G
abbrev C (n : ℕ) := Fin n → R

def quotient : Free →* G := PresentedGroup.mk rels
def monG : G →* R := MonoidAlgebra.of ℤ G
def mon : Free →* R := monG.comp quotient
def basis {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) : C n := Pi.single i 1

@[simp] theorem mon_mul_inv (w : Free) : mon w * mon w⁻¹ = 1 := by
  rw [← map_mul, mul_inv_cancel, map_one]

@[simp] theorem mon_inv_mul (w : Free) : mon w⁻¹ * mon w = 1 := by
  rw [← map_mul, inv_mul_cancel, map_one]

theorem mon_inv_one {w : Free} (h : mon w = 1) : mon w⁻¹ = 1 := by
  simpa only [h, one_mul] using mon_mul_inv w

theorem mon_relation {w : Free} (h : w ∈ rels) : mon w = 1 := by
  change monG (PresentedGroup.mk rels w) = 1
  rw [PresentedGroup.one_of_mem h, map_one]

@[simp] theorem mon_t1 : mon t1 = 1 := mon_relation (by simp [rels])
@[simp] theorem mon_t2 : mon t2 = 1 := mon_relation (by simp [rels])

def action : G →* MulAut (Multiplicative (C 5)) where
  toFun g :=
    { toFun := fun v => Multiplicative.ofAdd (monG g • v.toAdd)
      invFun := fun v => Multiplicative.ofAdd (monG g⁻¹ • v.toAdd)
      left_inv := by
        intro v
        change monG g⁻¹ • (monG g • v.toAdd) = v.toAdd
        rw [smul_smul, ← map_mul, inv_mul_cancel, map_one, one_smul]
      right_inv := by
        intro v
        change monG g • (monG g⁻¹ • v.toAdd) = v.toAdd
        rw [smul_smul, ← map_mul, mul_inv_cancel, map_one, one_smul]
      map_mul' := by
        intro v w
        change monG g • (v.toAdd + w.toAdd) =
          monG g • v.toAdd + monG g • w.toAdd
        exact smul_add _ _ _ }
  map_one' := by
    apply MulEquiv.ext
    intro v
    change monG 1 • v.toAdd = v.toAdd
    rw [map_one, one_smul]
  map_mul' := by
    intro g h
    apply MulEquiv.ext
    intro v
    change monG (g * h) • v.toAdd = monG g • (monG h • v.toAdd)
    rw [map_mul, mul_smul]

abbrev PathGroup := Multiplicative (C 5) ⋊[action] G

def path : Free →* PathGroup :=
  FreeGroup.lift fun i => ⟨Multiplicative.ofAdd (basis i), quotient (FreeGroup.of i)⟩

theorem path_right (w : Free) : (path w).right = quotient w := by
  have h : (SemidirectProduct.rightHom : PathGroup →* G).comp path = quotient :=
    FreeGroup.ext_hom _ _ (by intro i; simp [path])
  exact congrArg (fun f : Free →* G => f w) h

def fox (w : Free) : C 5 := (path w).left.toAdd

@[simp] theorem fox_one : fox 1 = 0 := by simp [fox]

@[simp] theorem fox_of (i : Fin 5) : fox (FreeGroup.of i) = basis i := by
  simp [fox, path]

theorem fox_mul (u v : Free) : fox (u * v) = fox u + mon u • fox v := by
  simp [fox, action, mon, path_right]

theorem fox_inv (w : Free) : fox w⁻¹ = -(mon w⁻¹ • fox w) := by
  simp [fox, action, mon, path_right, smul_neg]

def norm (n : ℕ) (a : R) : R := ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, a ^ j

theorem fox_pow (w : Free) (n : ℕ) : fox (w ^ n) = norm n (mon w) • fox w := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [norm]
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [pow_succ, fox_mul, ih, map_pow]
      simp [norm, Finset.sum_range_succ, add_smul]

def conjugate (c w : Free) : Free := c * w * c⁻¹
def commutator (u v : Free) : Free := u * v * u⁻¹ * v⁻¹

theorem mon_conjugate {w : Free} (h : mon w = 1) (c : Free) :
    mon (conjugate c w) = 1 := by
  simp [conjugate, map_mul, h]

theorem fox_conjugate {w : Free} (h : mon w = 1) (c : Free) :
    fox (conjugate c w) = mon c • fox w := by
  simp only [conjugate, fox_mul, fox_inv, map_mul, h, mul_one,
    smul_neg, smul_smul, mon_mul_inv, one_smul]
  abel

theorem mon_commutator {u : Free} (h : mon u = 1) (v : Free) :
    mon (commutator u v) = 1 := by
  simp [commutator, map_mul, h, mon_inv_one h]

theorem fox_commutator {u : Free} (h : mon u = 1) (v : Free) :
    fox (commutator u v) = (1 - mon v) • fox u := by
  simp only [commutator, fox_mul, fox_inv, map_mul, h, mon_inv_one h,
    one_mul, mul_one, one_smul, smul_neg, smul_smul, mon_mul_inv,
    sub_smul]
  abel

theorem fox_difference {u v : Free} (hu : mon u = 1) (hv : mon v = 1) :
    fox (u * v⁻¹) = fox u - fox v := by
  simp [fox_mul, fox_inv, hu, mon_inv_one hv, sub_eq_add_neg]

def rowMap {n m : ℕ} (rows : Fin n → C m) : C n →ₗ[R] C m where
  toFun v := ∑ i, v i • rows i
  map_add' v w := by simp [add_smul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  map_smul' a v := by simp [Finset.smul_sum, smul_smul]

@[simp] theorem rowMap_basis {n m : ℕ} (rows : Fin n → C m) (i : Fin n) :
    rowMap rows (basis i) = rows i := by
  classical
  simp [rowMap, basis, Pi.single_apply, ite_smul]

def original : Fin 4 → Free := ![r1, r2, r3, r4]
def dB : C 4 →ₗ[R] C 5 := rowMap (fun i => fox (original i))

theorem mon_original (i : Fin 4) : mon (original i) = 1 := by
  fin_cases i <;> apply mon_relation <;> simp [original, rels]

structure Factor where
  index : Fin 4
  conjugator : Free
  positive : Bool

def factorWord (f : Factor) : Free :=
  conjugate f.conjugator (if f.positive then original f.index else (original f.index)⁻¹)

def factorChain (f : Factor) : C 4 :=
  (if f.positive then mon f.conjugator else -mon f.conjugator) • basis f.index

def witnessWord (fs : List Factor) : Free := (fs.map factorWord).prod
def witnessChain (fs : List Factor) : C 4 := (fs.map factorChain).sum

theorem mon_factor (f : Factor) : mon (factorWord f) = 1 := by
  unfold factorWord
  apply mon_conjugate
  cases f.positive <;> simp [mon_original, mon_inv_one (mon_original f.index)]

theorem dB_factor (f : Factor) : dB (factorChain f) = fox (factorWord f) := by
  cases h : f.positive <;>
    simp [factorChain, factorWord, h, dB, fox_conjugate, mon_original,
      mon_inv_one (mon_original f.index), fox_inv, neg_smul]

theorem mon_witness (fs : List Factor) : mon (witnessWord fs) = 1 := by
  induction fs with
  | nil => simp [witnessWord]
  | cons f fs ih => simpa [witnessWord, map_mul, mon_factor] using ih

theorem dB_witness (fs : List Factor) : dB (witnessChain fs) = fox (witnessWord fs) := by
  induction fs with
  | nil => simp [witnessChain, witnessWord]
  | cons f fs ih =>
      simpa only [witnessChain, witnessWord, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons,
        List.prod_cons, map_add, fox_mul, mon_factor, one_smul, dB_factor] using
        congrArg (fun z => fox (factorWord f) + z) ih

def wU1 : List Factor :=
  [⟨0, X, true⟩, ⟨0, 1, true⟩, ⟨0, A ^ 4, true⟩,
   ⟨0, A ^ 8, true⟩, ⟨0, A ^ 12, true⟩]

def wU2 : List Factor :=
  [⟨1, Y ^ 2, true⟩, ⟨1, Y, true⟩, ⟨1, Y * B ^ 3, true⟩,
   ⟨1, Y * B ^ 6, true⟩, ⟨1, 1, true⟩, ⟨1, B ^ 3, true⟩,
   ⟨1, B ^ 6, true⟩, ⟨1, B ^ 9, true⟩, ⟨1, B ^ 12, true⟩,
   ⟨1, B ^ 15, true⟩, ⟨1, B ^ 18, true⟩, ⟨1, B ^ 21, true⟩,
   ⟨1, B ^ 24, true⟩]

def wP1 : List Factor := [⟨2, X, true⟩, ⟨2, 1, true⟩]
def wP2 : List Factor :=
  [⟨3, (S * Y * S⁻¹) ^ 2, true⟩, ⟨3, S * Y * S⁻¹, true⟩, ⟨3, 1, true⟩]

def invertFactor (f : Factor) : Factor := ⟨f.index, f.conjugator, !f.positive⟩

theorem factorChain_inverted (f : Factor) :
    factorChain (invertFactor f) = -factorChain f := by
  cases h : f.positive <;> simp [invertFactor, factorChain, h, neg_smul]

theorem witnessChain_inverted (fs : List Factor) :
    witnessChain (fs.reverse.map invertFactor) = -witnessChain fs := by
  simp [witnessChain, List.map_map, Function.comp_def, factorChain_inverted]
  induction fs with
  | nil => simp
  | cons f fs ih =>
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, ih]
      abel

theorem witnessChain_append (fs gs : List Factor) :
    witnessChain (fs ++ gs) = witnessChain fs + witnessChain gs := by
  simp [witnessChain]

def wE1 : List Factor := wP1 ++ wU2.reverse.map invertFactor
def wE2 : List Factor := wP2 ++ wU1.reverse.map invertFactor

theorem word_U1 : witnessWord wU1 = commutator t1 A * (A ^ 15)⁻¹ := by
  simp only [witnessWord, wU1, List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.prod_cons,
    List.prod_nil, factorWord, original, Matrix.cons_val_zero,
    if_true, conjugate, r1, commutator, t1]
  group
  simp [zpow_ofNat, pow_two, mul_assoc]

theorem word_U2 : witnessWord wU2 = commutator t2 B * (B ^ 26)⁻¹ := by
  simp [witnessWord, wU2, factorWord, original, conjugate, r2, commutator, t2]
  group

theorem word_P1 : witnessWord wP1 = t1 * (B ^ 26)⁻¹ := by
  simp [witnessWord, wP1, factorWord, original, conjugate, r3, t1]
  group
  simp [zpow_ofNat, pow_two, mul_assoc]

theorem word_P2 : witnessWord wP2 = conjugate S t2 * (A ^ 15)⁻¹ := by
  simp [witnessWord, wP2, factorWord, original, conjugate, r4, t2]
  group

theorem word_E1 : witnessWord wE1 = t1 * (commutator t2 B)⁻¹ := by
  simp [witnessWord, wE1, wP1, wU2, invertFactor, factorWord, original,
    conjugate, r3, r2, commutator, t1, t2]
  group
  simp [zpow_ofNat, pow_two, pow_succ Y 2, mul_assoc]

theorem word_E2 : witnessWord wE2 = conjugate S t2 * (commutator t1 A)⁻¹ := by
  simp [witnessWord, wE2, wP2, wU1, invertFactor, factorWord, original,
    conjugate, r4, r1, commutator, t1, t2]
  group
  simp [zpow_ofNat, pow_two, mul_assoc]

theorem A_order : mon A ^ 15 = 1 := by
  have h := mon_witness wP2
  rw [word_P2, map_mul, mon_conjugate mon_t2 S, one_mul] at h
  have k := mon_inv_mul (A ^ 15)
  rw [h, one_mul, map_pow] at k
  exact k

theorem B_order : mon B ^ 26 = 1 := by
  have h := mon_witness wP1
  rw [word_P1, map_mul, mon_t1, one_mul] at h
  have k := mon_inv_mul (B ^ 26)
  rw [h, one_mul, map_pow] at k
  exact k

def U1 : C 4 := witnessChain wU1
def U2 : C 4 := witnessChain wU2
def P1 : C 4 := witnessChain wP1
def P2 : C 4 := witnessChain wP2
def E1 : C 4 := P1 - U2
def E2 : C 4 := P2 - U1
def b1 : C 5 := fox t1
def b2 : C 5 := fox t2
def N15 : R := norm 15 (mon A)
def N26 : R := norm 26 (mon B)

theorem chain_E1 : witnessChain wE1 = E1 := by
  rw [wE1, witnessChain_append, witnessChain_inverted]
  simp only [E1, P1, U2, sub_eq_add_neg]

theorem chain_E2 : witnessChain wE2 = E2 := by
  rw [wE2, witnessChain_append, witnessChain_inverted]
  simp only [E2, P2, U1, sub_eq_add_neg]

theorem dB_U1 : dB U1 = (1 - mon A) • b1 - N15 • basis 1 := by
  rw [U1, dB_witness, word_U1,
    fox_difference (mon_commutator mon_t1 A) (by simpa only [map_pow] using A_order),
    fox_commutator mon_t1 A, fox_pow]
  simp only [b1, N15, A, fox_of]

theorem dB_U2 : dB U2 = (1 - mon B) • b2 - N26 • basis 3 := by
  rw [U2, dB_witness, word_U2,
    fox_difference (mon_commutator mon_t2 B) (by simpa only [map_pow] using B_order),
    fox_commutator mon_t2 B, fox_pow]
  simp only [b2, N26, B, fox_of]

theorem dB_P1 : dB P1 = b1 - N26 • basis 3 := by
  rw [P1, dB_witness, word_P1,
    fox_difference mon_t1 (by simpa only [map_pow] using B_order), fox_pow]
  simp only [b1, N26, B, fox_of]

theorem dB_P2 : dB P2 = mon S • b2 - N15 • basis 1 := by
  rw [P2, dB_witness, word_P2,
    fox_difference (mon_conjugate mon_t2 S) (by simpa only [map_pow] using A_order),
    fox_conjugate mon_t2 S, fox_pow]
  simp only [b2, N15, A, fox_of]

theorem dB_E1 : dB E1 = b1 - (1 - mon B) • b2 := by
  rw [E1, map_sub, dB_P1, dB_U2]
  abel

theorem dB_E2 : dB E2 = mon S • b2 - (1 - mon A) • b1 := by
  rw [E2, map_sub, dB_P2, dB_U1]
  abel

theorem norm_annihilator (n : ℕ) (a : R) (h : a ^ n = 1) :
    norm n a * (1 - a) = 0 := by
  simpa [norm, h] using geom_sum_mul_neg a n

theorem norm_square (n : ℕ) (a : R) (h : a ^ n = 1) :
    norm n a * norm n a = n • norm n a := by
  have hs : a * norm n a = norm n a := by
    have hz := mul_geom_sum a n
    change (a - 1) * norm n a = a ^ n - 1 at hz
    rw [h, sub_self, sub_mul, one_mul] at hz
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp hz
  have hi (j : ℕ) : a ^ j * norm n a = norm n a := by
    induction j with
    | zero => simp
    | succ j ih => rw [pow_succ', mul_assoc, ih, hs]
  calc
    norm n a * norm n a = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, a ^ j * norm n a := by
      exact Finset.sum_mul _ _ _
    _ = n • norm n a := by simp only [hi, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range]

def F26 : C 4 := (26 : ℕ) • P1 - N26 • U2
def F15_2 : C 4 := mon S⁻¹ • ((15 : ℕ) • P2 - N15 • U1)
def F15_1 : C 4 := (15 : ℕ) • E1 + (1 - mon B) • F15_2
def F1 : C 4 := (7 : ℕ) • F15_1 - (4 : ℕ) • F26
def F2 : C 4 := mon S⁻¹ • (E2 + (1 - mon A) • F1)

theorem dB_F26 : dB F26 = (26 : ℕ) • b1 := by
  rw [F26, map_sub, map_nsmul, map_smul, dB_P1, dB_U2]
  simp only [smul_sub, smul_smul, N26]
  rw [norm_annihilator 26 (mon B) B_order, norm_square 26 (mon B) B_order]
  simp only [zero_smul, sub_neg_eq_add, zero_sub, smul_assoc]
  abel

theorem dB_F15_2 : dB F15_2 = (15 : ℕ) • b2 := by
  have h : dB ((15 : ℕ) • P2 - N15 • U1) = (15 : ℕ) • (mon S • b2) := by
    rw [map_sub, map_nsmul, map_smul, dB_P2, dB_U1]
    simp only [smul_sub, smul_smul, N15]
    rw [norm_annihilator 15 (mon A) A_order, norm_square 15 (mon A) A_order]
    simp only [zero_smul, sub_neg_eq_add, zero_sub, smul_assoc]
    abel
  rw [F15_2, map_smul, h, smul_comm (mon S⁻¹) (15 : ℕ),
    smul_smul, mon_inv_mul, one_smul]

theorem dB_F15_1 : dB F15_1 = (15 : ℕ) • b1 := by
  rw [F15_1, map_add, map_nsmul, map_smul, dB_E1, dB_F15_2]
  rw [smul_sub, smul_comm (1 - mon B) (15 : ℕ)]
  abel

theorem dB_F1 : dB F1 = b1 := by
  rw [F1, map_sub, map_nsmul, map_nsmul, dB_F15_1, dB_F26]
  abel

theorem dB_F2 : dB F2 = b2 := by
  rw [F2, map_smul, map_add, map_smul, dB_E2, dB_F1]
  simp [smul_smul]

def fill : C 2 →ₗ[R] C 4 := rowMap ![F1, F2]
def addedBoundary : C 2 →ₗ[R] C 5 := rowMap ![b1, b2]

theorem fill_boundary (w : C 2) : dB (fill w) = addedBoundary w := by
  simp [fill, addedBoundary, rowMap, Fin.sum_univ_two, dB_F1, dB_F2]

abbrev C2 := C 4 × C 2

def D2 : C2 →ₗ[R] C 5 where
  toFun z := dB z.1 + addedBoundary z.2
  map_add' v w := by simp; abel
  map_smul' a v := by simp [smul_add]

def D3 : C 2 →ₗ[R] C2 where
  toFun w := (-fill w, w)
  map_add' v w := by simp [Prod.add_def]; abel
  map_smul' a v := by simp [Prod.smul_mk]

def q : C2 →ₗ[R] C 2 := LinearMap.snd R (C 4) (C 2)

def includeOld : C 4 →ₗ[R] C2 where
  toFun v := (v, 0)
  map_add' v w := by simp [Prod.add_def]
  map_smul' a v := by simp [Prod.smul_mk]

def retract : C2 →ₗ[R] C 4 where
  toFun z := z.1 + fill z.2
  map_add' v w := by simp; abel
  map_smul' a v := by simp [smul_add]

theorem D2_D3 (w : C 2) : D2 (D3 w) = 0 := by
  simp [D2, D3, fill_boundary]

theorem q_D3 (w : C 2) : q (D3 w) = w := rfl

theorem D3_injective : Function.Injective D3 := by
  intro u v h
  exact congrArg q h

theorem retract_include (v : C 4) : retract (includeOld v) = v := by
  simp [retract, includeOld]

theorem retract_D3 (w : C 2) : retract (D3 w) = 0 := by
  simp [retract, D3]

theorem boundary_retract (z : C2) : dB (retract z) = D2 z := by
  simp [retract, D2, fill_boundary]

theorem homotopy_degree_two (z : C2) :
    z - includeOld (retract z) = D3 (q z) := by
  apply Prod.ext
  · simp [includeOld, retract, D3, q]
  · simp [includeOld, D3, q]

theorem homotopy_degree_three (w : C 2) : q (D3 w) = w := q_D3 w

def splitCoordinates : C2 ≃ₗ[R] C2 where
  toFun z := (z.1 + fill z.2, z.2)
  invFun z := (z.1 - fill z.2, z.2)
  left_inv z := by simp
  right_inv z := by simp
  map_add' v w := by simp [Prod.add_def]; abel
  map_smul' a v := by simp [Prod.smul_mk, smul_add]

theorem split_D3 (w : C 2) : splitCoordinates (D3 w) = (0, w) := by
  simp [splitCoordinates, D3]

theorem split_boundary (z : C2) : D2 (splitCoordinates.symm z) = dB z.1 := by
  simp [splitCoordinates, D2, fill_boundary]

theorem cochain_extension {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    (f : C 2 →ₗ[R] M) : (f.comp q).comp D3 = f := by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro w
  rfl

def d1 : C 5 →ₗ[R] R where
  toFun v := ∑ i, v i * (mon (FreeGroup.of i) - 1)
  map_add' v w := by simp [add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  map_smul' a v := by simp [Finset.mul_sum, mul_assoc]

@[simp] theorem d1_basis (i : Fin 5) : d1 (basis i) = mon (FreeGroup.of i) - 1 := by
  classical
  simp [d1, basis, Pi.single_apply, ite_mul]

theorem fox_fundamental (w : Free) : d1 (fox w) = mon w - 1 := by
  refine FreeGroup.induction_on w ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · simp
  · intro i
    rw [fox_of, d1_basis]
  · intro i ih
    rw [fox_inv, map_neg, map_smul, ih]
    change -(mon (FreeGroup.of i)⁻¹ * (mon (FreeGroup.of i) - 1)) =
      mon (FreeGroup.of i)⁻¹ - 1
    rw [mul_sub, mon_inv_mul, mul_one]
    abel
  · intro u v hu hv
    rw [fox_mul, map_add, map_smul, hu, hv, map_mul]
    change (mon u - 1) + mon u * (mon v - 1) = mon u * mon v - 1
    noncomm_ring

theorem d1_dB (v : C 4) : d1 (dB v) = 0 := by
  simp [dB, rowMap, fox_fundamental, mon_original]

theorem d1_added (w : C 2) : d1 (addedBoundary w) = 0 := by
  simp [addedBoundary, rowMap, Fin.sum_univ_two, b1, b2, fox_fundamental]

theorem d1_D2 (z : C2) : d1 (D2 z) = 0 := by
  simp [D2, d1_dB, d1_added]

theorem instantiated_integral_plus :
    (∀ z : C2, d1 (D2 z) = 0) ∧
    (∀ w : C 2, D2 (D3 w) = 0 ∧ q (D3 w) = w) ∧
    (∀ v : C 4, retract (includeOld v) = v) ∧
    (∀ z : C2, dB (retract z) = D2 z ∧
      z - includeOld (retract z) = D3 (q z)) := by
  exact ⟨d1_D2, fun w => ⟨D2_D3 w, q_D3 w⟩, retract_include,
    fun z => ⟨boundary_retract z, homotopy_degree_two z⟩⟩

#print axioms instantiated_integral_plus
#print axioms cochain_extension

import Mathlib

open scoped BigOperators

noncomputable section

namespace TorsionFox

abbrev Word (n : ℕ) := FreeGroup (Fin n)
abbrev Vec (n : ℕ) := Fin n → ℂ

variable {n m : ℕ}

abbrev GroupOf (r : Fin m → Word n) := PresentedGroup (Set.range r)

def quotient (r : Fin m → Word n) : Word n →* GroupOf r :=
  PresentedGroup.mk (Set.range r)

def basis {k : ℕ} (i : Fin k) : Vec k := Pi.single i 1

section Differential

variable (r : Fin m → Word n) (ρ : GroupOf r →* ℂˣ)

def evalGroup : GroupOf r →* ℂ := (Units.coeHom ℂ).comp ρ
def evalWord : Word n →* ℂ := (evalGroup r ρ).comp (quotient r)

@[simp] theorem eval_mul_inv (w : Word n) :
    evalWord r ρ w * evalWord r ρ w⁻¹ = 1 := by
  rw [← map_mul, mul_inv_cancel, map_one]

@[simp] theorem eval_inv_mul (w : Word n) :
    evalWord r ρ w⁻¹ * evalWord r ρ w = 1 := by
  rw [← map_mul, inv_mul_cancel, map_one]

theorem eval_inv_one {w : Word n} (h : evalWord r ρ w = 1) :
    evalWord r ρ w⁻¹ = 1 := by
  simpa only [h, one_mul] using eval_mul_inv r ρ w

@[simp] theorem quotient_relator (j : Fin m) : quotient r (r j) = 1 :=
  PresentedGroup.one_of_mem ⟨j, rfl⟩

@[simp] theorem eval_relator (j : Fin m) : evalWord r ρ (r j) = 1 := by
  change evalGroup r ρ (quotient r (r j)) = 1
  rw [quotient_relator, map_one]

def action : GroupOf r →* MulAut (Multiplicative (Vec n)) where
  toFun g :=
    { toFun := fun v => Multiplicative.ofAdd (evalGroup r ρ g • v.toAdd)
      invFun := fun v => Multiplicative.ofAdd (evalGroup r ρ g⁻¹ • v.toAdd)
      left_inv := by
        intro v
        change evalGroup r ρ g⁻¹ • (evalGroup r ρ g • v.toAdd) = v.toAdd
        rw [smul_smul, ← map_mul, inv_mul_cancel, map_one, one_smul]
      right_inv := by
        intro v
        change evalGroup r ρ g • (evalGroup r ρ g⁻¹ • v.toAdd) = v.toAdd
        rw [smul_smul, ← map_mul, mul_inv_cancel, map_one, one_smul]
      map_mul' := by
        intro v w
        change evalGroup r ρ g • (v.toAdd + w.toAdd) =
          evalGroup r ρ g • v.toAdd + evalGroup r ρ g • w.toAdd
        exact smul_add _ _ _ }
  map_one' := by
    apply MulEquiv.ext
    intro v
    change evalGroup r ρ 1 • v.toAdd = v.toAdd
    rw [map_one, one_smul]
  map_mul' := by
    intro g h
    apply MulEquiv.ext
    intro v
    change evalGroup r ρ (g * h) • v.toAdd =
      evalGroup r ρ g • (evalGroup r ρ h • v.toAdd)
    rw [map_mul, mul_smul]

abbrev PathGroup := Multiplicative (Vec n) ⋊[action r ρ] GroupOf r

def path : Word n →* PathGroup r ρ :=
  FreeGroup.lift fun i =>
    ⟨Multiplicative.ofAdd (basis i), quotient r (FreeGroup.of i)⟩

theorem path_right (w : Word n) : (path r ρ w).right = quotient r w := by
  have h : (SemidirectProduct.rightHom : PathGroup r ρ →* GroupOf r).comp
      (path r ρ) = quotient r :=
    FreeGroup.ext_hom _ _ (by intro i; simp [path])
  exact congrArg (fun f : Word n →* GroupOf r => f w) h

def fox (w : Word n) : Vec n := (path r ρ w).left.toAdd

@[simp] theorem fox_one : fox r ρ 1 = 0 := by simp [fox]

@[simp] theorem fox_generator (i : Fin n) : fox r ρ (FreeGroup.of i) = basis i := by
  simp [fox, path]

theorem fox_mul (u v : Word n) :
    fox r ρ (u * v) = fox r ρ u + evalWord r ρ u • fox r ρ v := by
  simp [fox, action, evalWord, path_right]

theorem fox_inv (w : Word n) :
    fox r ρ w⁻¹ = -(evalWord r ρ w⁻¹ • fox r ρ w) := by
  simp [fox, action, evalWord, path_right, smul_neg]

def norm (q : ℕ) (a : ℂ) : ℂ := ∑ k ∈ Finset.range q, a ^ k

theorem fox_pow (w : Word n) (q : ℕ) :
    fox r ρ (w ^ q) = norm q (evalWord r ρ w) • fox r ρ w := by
  induction q with
  | zero => simp [norm]
  | succ q ih =>
      rw [pow_succ, fox_mul, ih, map_pow]
      simp [norm, Finset.sum_range_succ, add_smul]

def boundary : Vec m →ₗ[ℂ] Vec n where
  toFun c := ∑ j, c j • fox r ρ (r j)
  map_add' c d := by simp [add_smul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  map_smul' a c := by simp [Finset.smul_sum, smul_smul]

@[simp] theorem boundary_basis (j : Fin m) :
    boundary r ρ (basis j) = fox r ρ (r j) := by
  classical
  simp [boundary, basis, Pi.single_apply, ite_smul]

def firstBoundary : Vec n →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ where
  toFun v := ∑ i, v i * (evalWord r ρ (FreeGroup.of i) - 1)
  map_add' v w := by simp [add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  map_smul' a v := by simp [Finset.mul_sum, mul_assoc]

@[simp] theorem firstBoundary_basis (i : Fin n) :
    firstBoundary r ρ (basis i) = evalWord r ρ (FreeGroup.of i) - 1 := by
  classical
  simp [firstBoundary, basis, Pi.single_apply, ite_mul]

theorem fox_fundamental (w : Word n) :
    firstBoundary r ρ (fox r ρ w) = evalWord r ρ w - 1 := by
  refine FreeGroup.induction_on w ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · simp
  · intro i
    simp
  · intro i hi
    simp only [fox_inv, map_neg, map_smul, hi, smul_eq_mul]
    linear_combination -(eval_inv_mul r ρ (FreeGroup.of i))
  · intro u v hu hv
    rw [fox_mul, map_add, map_smul, hu, hv, map_mul]
    simp only [smul_eq_mul]
    ring

theorem firstBoundary_boundary (c : Vec m) :
    firstBoundary r ρ (boundary r ρ c) = 0 := by
  change firstBoundary r ρ (∑ j, c j • fox r ρ (r j)) = 0
  simp [map_sum, map_smul, fox_fundamental]

theorem fox_conjugate {v : Word n} (hv : evalWord r ρ v = 1) (u : Word n) :
    fox r ρ (u * v * u⁻¹) = evalWord r ρ u • fox r ρ v := by
  simp only [fox_mul, fox_inv, map_mul, hv, mul_one, smul_neg,
    smul_smul, eval_mul_inv, one_smul]
  abel

end Differential

structure Factor (n m : ℕ) where
  index : Fin m
  conjugator : Word n
  positive : Bool

def factorWord (r : Fin m → Word n) (f : Factor n m) : Word n :=
  f.conjugator * (if f.positive then r f.index else (r f.index)⁻¹) * f.conjugator⁻¹

def witnessWord (r : Fin m → Word n) : List (Factor n m) → Word n
  | [] => 1
  | f :: fs => factorWord r f * witnessWord r fs

def invertFactor (f : Factor n m) : Factor n m :=
  ⟨f.index, f.conjugator, !f.positive⟩

def invertWitness : List (Factor n m) → List (Factor n m)
  | [] => []
  | f :: fs => invertWitness fs ++ [invertFactor f]

def conjugateFactor (u : Word n) (f : Factor n m) : Factor n m :=
  ⟨f.index, u * f.conjugator, f.positive⟩

theorem witnessWord_append (r : Fin m → Word n) (fs gs : List (Factor n m)) :
    witnessWord r (fs ++ gs) = witnessWord r fs * witnessWord r gs := by
  induction fs with
  | nil => simp [witnessWord]
  | cons f fs ih => simp [witnessWord, ih, mul_assoc]

theorem factorWord_invert (r : Fin m → Word n) (f : Factor n m) :
    factorWord r (invertFactor f) = (factorWord r f)⁻¹ := by
  cases h : f.positive <;> simp [factorWord, invertFactor, h, mul_assoc]

theorem witnessWord_invert (r : Fin m → Word n) (fs : List (Factor n m)) :
    witnessWord r (invertWitness fs) = (witnessWord r fs)⁻¹ := by
  induction fs with
  | nil => simp [invertWitness, witnessWord]
  | cons f fs ih =>
      simp [invertWitness, witnessWord_append, witnessWord, ih, factorWord_invert]

theorem factorWord_conjugate (r : Fin m → Word n) (u : Word n) (f : Factor n m) :
    factorWord r (conjugateFactor u f) = u * factorWord r f * u⁻¹ := by
  simp [factorWord, conjugateFactor, mul_assoc]

theorem witnessWord_conjugate (r : Fin m → Word n) (u : Word n)
    (fs : List (Factor n m)) :
    witnessWord r (fs.map (conjugateFactor u)) = u * witnessWord r fs * u⁻¹ := by
  induction fs with
  | nil => simp [witnessWord]
  | cons f fs ih =>
      simp [witnessWord, factorWord_conjugate, ih, mul_assoc]

def witnessSubgroup (r : Fin m → Word n) : Subgroup (Word n) where
  carrier w := ∃ fs, witnessWord r fs = w
  one_mem' := ⟨[], rfl⟩
  mul_mem' := by
    rintro a b ⟨fs, rfl⟩ ⟨gs, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨fs ++ gs, witnessWord_append r fs gs⟩
  inv_mem' := by
    rintro a ⟨fs, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨invertWitness fs, witnessWord_invert r fs⟩

instance witnessSubgroup_normal (r : Fin m → Word n) : (witnessSubgroup r).Normal where
  conj_mem := by
    rintro a ⟨fs, rfl⟩ u
    exact ⟨fs.map (conjugateFactor u), witnessWord_conjugate r u fs⟩

theorem exists_witness (r : Fin m → Word n) {w : Word n}
    (hw : quotient r w = 1) : ∃ fs, witnessWord r fs = w := by
  have hle : Subgroup.normalClosure (Set.range r) ≤ witnessSubgroup r := by
    apply Subgroup.normalClosure_le_normal
    rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨[⟨j, 1, true⟩], by simp [witnessWord, factorWord]⟩
  exact hle (PresentedGroup.mk_eq_one_iff.mp hw)

section Certificates

variable (r : Fin m → Word n) (ρ : GroupOf r →* ℂˣ)

def factorChain (f : Factor n m) : Vec m :=
  (if f.positive then evalWord r ρ f.conjugator
    else -evalWord r ρ f.conjugator) • basis f.index

def witnessChain : List (Factor n m) → Vec m
  | [] => 0
  | f :: fs => factorChain r ρ f + witnessChain fs

@[simp] theorem eval_factor (f : Factor n m) : evalWord r ρ (factorWord r f) = 1 := by
  unfold factorWord
  split_ifs
  · rw [map_mul, map_mul, eval_relator, mul_one, eval_mul_inv]
  · rw [map_mul, map_mul, eval_inv_one r ρ (eval_relator r ρ f.index),
      mul_one, eval_mul_inv]

theorem boundary_factor (f : Factor n m) :
    boundary r ρ (factorChain r ρ f) = fox r ρ (factorWord r f) := by
  cases h : f.positive <;>
    simp [factorChain, factorWord, h, fox_conjugate, eval_relator,
      eval_inv_one r ρ (eval_relator r ρ f.index), fox_inv, neg_smul]

theorem boundary_witness (fs : List (Factor n m)) :
    boundary r ρ (witnessChain r ρ fs) = fox r ρ (witnessWord r fs) := by
  induction fs with
  | nil => simp [witnessChain, witnessWord]
  | cons f fs ih =>
      simp [witnessChain, witnessWord, map_add, fox_mul, boundary_factor, ih]

end Certificates

theorem norm_mul_sub (q : ℕ) (a : ℂ) :
    norm q a * (a - 1) = a ^ q - 1 := by
  induction q with
  | zero => simp [norm]
  | succ q ih =>
      have hs : norm (q + 1) a = norm q a + a ^ q := by
        simp [norm, Finset.sum_range_succ]
      rw [hs, pow_succ]
      calc
        (norm q a + a ^ q) * (a - 1) =
            norm q a * (a - 1) + a ^ q * a - a ^ q := by ring
        _ = a ^ q * a - 1 := by rw [ih]; ring

theorem norm_zero {q : ℕ} {a : ℂ} (ha : a ≠ 1) (hq : a ^ q = 1) :
    norm q a = 0 := by
  have h := norm_mul_sub q a
  rw [hq, sub_self] at h
  exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h).resolve_right (sub_ne_zero.mpr ha)

section Torsion

variable (r : Fin m → Word n) (ρ : GroupOf r →* ℂˣ)

theorem torsion_fox_zero {w : Word n} {q : ℕ}
    (hq : (quotient r w) ^ q = 1) (hρ : ρ (quotient r w) ≠ 1) :
    fox r ρ (w ^ q) = 0 := by
  have ha : evalWord r ρ w ≠ 1 := by
    intro h
    apply hρ
    apply Units.ext
    simpa [evalWord, evalGroup] using h
  have hp : (evalWord r ρ w) ^ q = 1 := by
    have h := congrArg (fun g : GroupOf r => evalGroup r ρ g) hq
    simpa [evalWord] using h
  rw [fox_pow, norm_zero ha hp, zero_smul]

theorem torsion_witness_in_kernel {w : Word n} {q : ℕ}
    (hq : (quotient r w) ^ q = 1) (hρ : ρ (quotient r w) ≠ 1)
    (fs : List (Factor n m)) (hfs : witnessWord r fs = w ^ q) :
    boundary r ρ (witnessChain r ρ fs) = 0 := by
  rw [boundary_witness, hfs]
  exact torsion_fox_zero r ρ hq hρ

theorem injective_boundary_forces_zero_certificate {w : Word n} {q : ℕ}
    (hinj : Function.Injective (boundary r ρ))
    (hq : (quotient r w) ^ q = 1) (hρ : ρ (quotient r w) ≠ 1)
    (fs : List (Factor n m)) (hfs : witnessWord r fs = w ^ q) :
    witnessChain r ρ fs = 0 := by
  apply hinj
  rw [torsion_witness_in_kernel r ρ hq hρ fs hfs, map_zero]

theorem torsion_has_certificate {w : Word n} {q : ℕ}
    (hq : (quotient r w) ^ q = 1) :
    ∃ fs, witnessWord r fs = w ^ q :=
  exists_witness r (by simpa only [map_pow] using hq)

theorem torsion_element_has_certificate (g : GroupOf r) (q : ℕ) (hq : g ^ q = 1) :
    ∃ (w : Word n) (fs : List (Factor n m)),
      quotient r w = g ∧ witnessWord r fs = w ^ q := by
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := PresentedGroup.mk_surjective (Set.range r) g
  have hw' : quotient r w = g := hw
  obtain ⟨fs, hfs⟩ :=
    torsion_has_certificate r (w := w) (q := q) (by rw [hw']; exact hq)
  exact ⟨w, fs, hw, hfs⟩

end Torsion

def UniversalTorsionStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ (n m : ℕ) (r : Fin m → Word n) (ρ : GroupOf r →* ℂˣ),
    Function.Injective (boundary r ρ) →
    ∀ (g : GroupOf r) (q : ℕ), 0 < q → g ^ q = 1 → ρ g = 1

namespace Cancellation

def x : Word 1 := FreeGroup.of 0
def relator : Fin 1 → Word 1 := fun _ => x ^ 6
def witness : List (Factor 1 1) :=
  [⟨0, 1, true⟩, ⟨0, x, false⟩, ⟨0, x ^ 2, true⟩]

def zeta : ℂ := (1 + (Real.sqrt 3 : ℂ) * Complex.I) / 2

theorem zeta_quadratic : zeta ^ 2 - zeta + 1 = 0 := by
  have hs : (Real.sqrt 3) ^ 2 = 3 := Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num)
  apply Complex.ext <;> norm_num [zeta, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im, pow_two] <;>
    nlinarith

theorem zeta_sixth_power : zeta ^ 6 = 1 := by
  linear_combination (zeta ^ 4 + zeta ^ 3 - zeta - 1) * zeta_quadratic

theorem zeta_ne_zero : zeta ≠ 0 := by
  intro h
  have hz := zeta_quadratic
  norm_num [h] at hz

theorem zeta_ne_one : zeta ≠ 1 := by
  intro h
  have hz := zeta_quadratic
  norm_num [h] at hz

def zetaUnit : ℂˣ := Units.mk0 zeta zeta_ne_zero

theorem zetaUnit_sixth_power : zetaUnit ^ 6 = 1 := by
  apply Units.ext
  exact zeta_sixth_power

def character : GroupOf relator →* ℂˣ :=
  PresentedGroup.toGroup (f := fun _ : Fin 1 => zetaUnit) (by
    rintro w ⟨j, rfl⟩
    simpa [relator, x] using zetaUnit_sixth_power)

@[simp] theorem character_generator : character (quotient relator x) = zetaUnit := by
  exact PresentedGroup.toGroup.of _

@[simp] theorem eval_generator : evalWord relator character x = zeta := by
  change (character (quotient relator x) : ℂ) = zeta
  rw [character_generator]
  rfl

theorem word_identity : witnessWord relator witness = x ^ 6 := by
  simp [witnessWord, witness, factorWord, relator]
  group

theorem coefficient_zero (ρ : GroupOf relator →* ℂˣ)
    (hζ : (evalWord relator ρ x) ^ 2 - evalWord relator ρ x + 1 = 0) :
    witnessChain relator ρ witness = 0 := by
  ext i
  fin_cases i
  simpa [witnessChain, witness, factorChain, basis, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm,
    add_left_comm, add_assoc] using hζ

theorem exact_zero_certificate :
    (quotient relator x) ^ 6 = 1 ∧
      character (quotient relator x) ≠ 1 ∧
      witnessWord relator witness = x ^ 6 ∧
      witnessChain relator character witness = 0 := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, word_identity, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [relator, map_pow] using quotient_relator relator (0 : Fin 1)
  · rw [character_generator]
    intro h
    apply zeta_ne_one
    exact congrArg (fun u : ℂˣ => (u : ℂ)) h
  · apply coefficient_zero
    simpa using zeta_quadratic

theorem boundary_not_injective : ¬ Function.Injective (boundary relator character) := by
  intro h
  have hz : fox relator character (x ^ 6) = 0 :=
    torsion_fox_zero relator character exact_zero_certificate.1
      exact_zero_certificate.2.1
  have he : boundary relator character (basis (0 : Fin 1)) =
      boundary relator character 0 := by
    rw [boundary_basis, map_zero]
    exact hz
  have hc := congrFun (h he) (0 : Fin 1)
  norm_num [basis] at hc

end Cancellation

end TorsionFox

      map_mul' := by
        intro v w
        change evalGroup r ρ g • (v.toAdd + w.toAdd) =
          evalGroup r ρ g • v.toAdd + evalGroup r ρ g • w.toAdd
        exact smul_add _ _ _ }
  map_one' := by
    apply MulEquiv.ext
    intro v
    change evalGroup r ρ 1 • v.toAdd = v.toAdd
    rw [map_one, one_smul]
  map_mul' := by
    intro g h
    apply MulEquiv.ext
    intro v
    change evalGroup r ρ (g * h) • v.toAdd =
      evalGroup r ρ g • (evalGroup r ρ h • v.toAdd)
    rw [map_mul, mul_smul]

abbrev PathGroup := Multiplicative (Vec n) ⋊[action r ρ] GroupOf r

def path : Word n →* PathGroup r ρ :=
  FreeGroup.lift fun i =>
    ⟨Multiplicative.ofAdd (basis i), quotient r (FreeGroup.of i)⟩

theorem path_right (w : Word n) : (path r ρ w).right = quotient r w := by
  have h : (SemidirectProduct.rightHom : PathGroup r ρ →* GroupOf r).comp
      (path r ρ) = quotient r :=
    FreeGroup.ext_hom _ _ (by intro i; simp [path])
  exact congrArg (fun f : Word n →* GroupOf r => f w) h

def fox (w : Word n) : Vec n := (path r ρ w).left.toAdd

@[simp] theorem fox_one : fox r ρ 1 = 0 := by simp [fox]

@[simp] theorem fox_generator (i : Fin n) : fox r ρ (FreeGroup.of i) = basis i := by
  simp [fox, path]

theorem fox_mul (u v : Word n) :
    fox r ρ (u * v) = fox r ρ u + evalWord r ρ u • fox r ρ v := by
  simp [fox, action, evalWord, path_right]

theorem fox_inv (w : Word n) :
    fox r ρ w⁻¹ = -(evalWord r ρ w⁻¹ • fox r ρ w) := by
  simp [fox, action, evalWord, path_right, smul_neg]

def norm (q : ℕ) (a : ℂ) : ℂ := ∑ k ∈ Finset.range q, a ^ k

theorem fox_pow (w : Word n) (q : ℕ) :
    fox r ρ (w ^ q) = norm q (evalWord r ρ w) • fox r ρ w := by
  induction q with
  | zero => simp [norm]
  | succ q ih =>
      rw [pow_succ, fox_mul, ih, map_pow]
      simp [norm, Finset.sum_range_succ, add_smul]

def boundary : Vec m →ₗ[ℂ] Vec n where
  toFun c := ∑ j, c j • fox r ρ (r j)
  map_add' c d := by simp [add_smul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  map_smul' a c := by simp [Finset.smul_sum, smul_smul]

@[simp] theorem boundary_basis (j : Fin m) :
    boundary r ρ (basis j) = fox r ρ (r j) := by
  classical
  simp [boundary, basis, Pi.single_apply, ite_smul]

def firstBoundary : Vec n →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ where
  toFun v := ∑ i, v i * (evalWord r ρ (FreeGroup.of i) - 1)
  map_add' v w := by simp [add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  map_smul' a v := by simp [Finset.mul_sum, mul_assoc]

@[simp] theorem firstBoundary_basis (i : Fin n) :
    firstBoundary r ρ (basis i) = evalWord r ρ (FreeGroup.of i) - 1 := by
  classical
  simp [firstBoundary, basis, Pi.single_apply, ite_mul]

theorem fox_fundamental (w : Word n) :
    firstBoundary r ρ (fox r ρ w) = evalWord r ρ w - 1 := by
  refine FreeGroup.induction_on w ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · simp
  · intro i
    simp
  · intro i hi
    simp only [fox_inv, map_neg, map_smul, hi, smul_eq_mul]
    linear_combination -(eval_inv_mul r ρ (FreeGroup.of i))
  · intro u v hu hv
    rw [fox_mul, map_add, map_smul, hu, hv, map_mul]
    simp only [smul_eq_mul]
    ring

theorem firstBoundary_boundary (c : Vec m) :
    firstBoundary r ρ (boundary r ρ c) = 0 := by
  change firstBoundary r ρ (∑ j, c j • fox r ρ (r j)) = 0
  simp [map_sum, map_smul, fox_fundamental]

theorem fox_conjugate {v : Word n} (hv : evalWord r ρ v = 1) (u : Word n) :
    fox r ρ (u * v * u⁻¹) = evalWord r ρ u • fox r ρ v := by
  simp only [fox_mul, fox_inv, map_mul, hv, mul_one, smul_neg,
    smul_smul, eval_mul_inv, one_smul]
  abel

end Differential

structure Factor (n m : ℕ) where
  index : Fin m
  conjugator : Word n
  positive : Bool

def factorWord (r : Fin m → Word n) (f : Factor n m) : Word n :=
  f.conjugator * (if f.positive then r f.index else (r f.index)⁻¹) * f.conjugator⁻¹

def witnessWord (r : Fin m → Word n) : List (Factor n m) → Word n
  | [] => 1
  | f :: fs => factorWord r f * witnessWord r fs

def invertFactor (f : Factor n m) : Factor n m :=
  ⟨f.index, f.conjugator, !f.positive⟩

def invertWitness : List (Factor n m) → List (Factor n m)
  | [] => []
  | f :: fs => invertWitness fs ++ [invertFactor f]

def conjugateFactor (u : Word n) (f : Factor n m) : Factor n m :=
  ⟨f.index, u * f.conjugator, f.positive⟩

theorem witnessWord_append (r : Fin m → Word n) (fs gs : List (Factor n m)) :
    witnessWord r (fs ++ gs) = witnessWord r fs * witnessWord r gs := by
  induction fs with
  | nil => simp [witnessWord]
  | cons f fs ih => simp [witnessWord, ih, mul_assoc]

theorem factorWord_invert (r : Fin m → Word n) (f : Factor n m) :
    factorWord r (invertFactor f) = (factorWord r f)⁻¹ := by
  cases h : f.positive <;> simp [factorWord, invertFactor, h, mul_assoc]

theorem witnessWord_invert (r : Fin m → Word n) (fs : List (Factor n m)) :
    witnessWord r (invertWitness fs) = (witnessWord r fs)⁻¹ := by
  induction fs with
  | nil => simp [invertWitness, witnessWord]
  | cons f fs ih =>
      simp [invertWitness, witnessWord_append, witnessWord, ih, factorWord_invert]

theorem factorWord_conjugate (r : Fin m → Word n) (u : Word n) (f : Factor n m) :
    factorWord r (conjugateFactor u f) = u * factorWord r f * u⁻¹ := by
  simp [factorWord, conjugateFactor, mul_assoc]

theorem witnessWord_conjugate (r : Fin m → Word n) (u : Word n)
    (fs : List (Factor n m)) :
    witnessWord r (fs.map (conjugateFactor u)) = u * witnessWord r fs * u⁻¹ := by
  induction fs with
  | nil => simp [witnessWord]
  | cons f fs ih =>
      simp [witnessWord, factorWord_conjugate, ih, mul_assoc]

def witnessSubgroup (r : Fin m → Word n) : Subgroup (Word n) where
  carrier w := ∃ fs, witnessWord r fs = w
  one_mem' := ⟨[], rfl⟩
  mul_mem' := by
    rintro a b ⟨fs, rfl⟩ ⟨gs, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨fs ++ gs, witnessWord_append r fs gs⟩
  inv_mem' := by
    rintro a ⟨fs, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨invertWitness fs, witnessWord_invert r fs⟩

instance witnessSubgroup_normal (r : Fin m → Word n) : (witnessSubgroup r).Normal where
  conj_mem := by
    rintro a ⟨fs, rfl⟩ u
    exact ⟨fs.map (conjugateFactor u), witnessWord_conjugate r u fs⟩

theorem exists_witness (r : Fin m → Word n) {w : Word n}
    (hw : quotient r w = 1) : ∃ fs, witnessWord r fs = w := by
  have hle : Subgroup.normalClosure (Set.range r) ≤ witnessSubgroup r := by
    apply Subgroup.normalClosure_le_normal
    rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨[⟨j, 1, true⟩], by simp [witnessWord, factorWord]⟩
  exact hle (PresentedGroup.mk_eq_one_iff.mp hw)

section Certificates

variable (r : Fin m → Word n) (ρ : GroupOf r →* ℂˣ)

def factorChain (f : Factor n m) : Vec m :=
  (if f.positive then evalWord r ρ f.conjugator
    else -evalWord r ρ f.conjugator) • basis f.index

def witnessChain : List (Factor n m) → Vec m
  | [] => 0
  | f :: fs => factorChain r ρ f + witnessChain fs

@[simp] theorem eval_factor (f : Factor n m) : evalWord r ρ (factorWord r f) = 1 := by
  unfold factorWord
  split_ifs
  · rw [map_mul, map_mul, eval_relator, mul_one, eval_mul_inv]
  · rw [map_mul, map_mul, eval_inv_one r ρ (eval_relator r ρ f.index),
      mul_one, eval_mul_inv]

theorem boundary_factor (f : Factor n m) :
    boundary r ρ (factorChain r ρ f) = fox r ρ (factorWord r f) := by
  cases h : f.positive <;>
    simp [factorChain, factorWord, h, fox_conjugate, eval_relator,
      eval_inv_one r ρ (eval_relator r ρ f.index), fox_inv, neg_smul]

theorem boundary_witness (fs : List (Factor n m)) :
    boundary r ρ (witnessChain r ρ fs) = fox r ρ (witnessWord r fs) := by
  induction fs with
  | nil => simp [witnessChain, witnessWord]
  | cons f fs ih =>
      simp [witnessChain, witnessWord, map_add, fox_mul, boundary_factor, ih]

end Certificates

theorem norm_mul_sub (q : ℕ) (a : ℂ) :
    norm q a * (a - 1) = a ^ q - 1 := by
  induction q with
  | zero => simp [norm]
  | succ q ih =>
      have hs : norm (q + 1) a = norm q a + a ^ q := by
        simp [norm, Finset.sum_range_succ]
      rw [hs, pow_succ]
      calc
        (norm q a + a ^ q) * (a - 1) =
            norm q a * (a - 1) + a ^ q * a - a ^ q := by ring
        _ = a ^ q * a - 1 := by rw [ih]; ring

theorem norm_zero {q : ℕ} {a : ℂ} (ha : a ≠ 1) (hq : a ^ q = 1) :
    norm q a = 0 := by
  have h := norm_mul_sub q a
  rw [hq, sub_self] at h
  exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h).resolve_right (sub_ne_zero.mpr ha)

section Torsion

variable (r : Fin m → Word n) (ρ : GroupOf r →* ℂˣ)

theorem torsion_fox_zero {w : Word n} {q : ℕ}
    (hq : (quotient r w) ^ q = 1) (hρ : ρ (quotient r w) ≠ 1) :
    fox r ρ (w ^ q) = 0 := by
  have ha : evalWord r ρ w ≠ 1 := by
    intro h
    apply hρ
    apply Units.ext
    simpa [evalWord, evalGroup] using h
  have hp : (evalWord r ρ w) ^ q = 1 := by
    have h := congrArg (fun g : GroupOf r => evalGroup r ρ g) hq
    simpa [evalWord] using h
  rw [fox_pow, norm_zero ha hp, zero_smul]

theorem torsion_witness_in_kernel {w : Word n} {q : ℕ}
    (hq : (quotient r w) ^ q = 1) (hρ : ρ (quotient r w) ≠ 1)
    (fs : List (Factor n m)) (hfs : witnessWord r fs = w ^ q) :
    boundary r ρ (witnessChain r ρ fs) = 0 := by
  rw [boundary_witness, hfs]
  exact torsion_fox_zero r ρ hq hρ

theorem injective_boundary_forces_zero_certificate {w : Word n} {q : ℕ}
    (hinj : Function.Injective (boundary r ρ))
    (hq : (quotient r w) ^ q = 1) (hρ : ρ (quotient r w) ≠ 1)
    (fs : List (Factor n m)) (hfs : witnessWord r fs = w ^ q) :
    witnessChain r ρ fs = 0 := by
  apply hinj
  rw [torsion_witness_in_kernel r ρ hq hρ fs hfs, map_zero]

theorem torsion_has_certificate {w : Word n} {q : ℕ}
    (hq : (quotient r w) ^ q = 1) :
    ∃ fs, witnessWord r fs = w ^ q :=
  exists_witness r (by simpa only [map_pow] using hq)

theorem torsion_element_has_certificate (g : GroupOf r) (q : ℕ) (hq : g ^ q = 1) :
    ∃ (w : Word n) (fs : List (Factor n m)),
      quotient r w = g ∧ witnessWord r fs = w ^ q := by
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := PresentedGroup.mk_surjective (Set.range r) g
  have hw' : quotient r w = g := hw
  obtain ⟨fs, hfs⟩ :=
    torsion_has_certificate r (w := w) (q := q) (by rw [hw']; exact hq)
  exact ⟨w, fs, hw, hfs⟩

end Torsion

def UniversalTorsionStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ (n m : ℕ) (r : Fin m → Word n) (ρ : GroupOf r →* ℂˣ),
    Function.Injective (boundary r ρ) →
    ∀ (g : GroupOf r) (q : ℕ), 0 < q → g ^ q = 1 → ρ g = 1

namespace Cancellation

def x : Word 1 := FreeGroup.of 0
def relator : Fin 1 → Word 1 := fun _ => x ^ 6
def witness : List (Factor 1 1) :=
  [⟨0, 1, true⟩, ⟨0, x, false⟩, ⟨0, x ^ 2, true⟩]

def zeta : ℂ := (1 + (Real.sqrt 3 : ℂ) * Complex.I) / 2

theorem zeta_quadratic : zeta ^ 2 - zeta + 1 = 0 := by
  have hs : (Real.sqrt 3) ^ 2 = 3 := Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num)
  apply Complex.ext <;> norm_num [zeta, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im, pow_two] <;>
    nlinarith

theorem zeta_sixth_power : zeta ^ 6 = 1 := by
  linear_combination (zeta ^ 4 + zeta ^ 3 - zeta - 1) * zeta_quadratic

theorem zeta_ne_zero : zeta ≠ 0 := by
  intro h
  have hz := zeta_quadratic
  norm_num [h] at hz

theorem zeta_ne_one : zeta ≠ 1 := by
  intro h
  have hz := zeta_quadratic
  norm_num [h] at hz

def zetaUnit : ℂˣ := Units.mk0 zeta zeta_ne_zero

theorem zetaUnit_sixth_power : zetaUnit ^ 6 = 1 := by
  apply Units.ext
  exact zeta_sixth_power

def character : GroupOf relator →* ℂˣ :=
  PresentedGroup.toGroup (f := fun _ : Fin 1 => zetaUnit) (by
    rintro w ⟨j, rfl⟩
    simpa [relator, x] using zetaUnit_sixth_power)

@[simp] theorem character_generator : character (quotient relator x) = zetaUnit := by
  exact PresentedGroup.toGroup.of _

@[simp] theorem eval_generator : evalWord relator character x = zeta := by
  change (character (quotient relator x) : ℂ) = zeta
  rw [character_generator]
  rfl

theorem word_identity : witnessWord relator witness = x ^ 6 := by
  simp [witnessWord, witness, factorWord, relator]
  group

theorem coefficient_zero (ρ : GroupOf relator →* ℂˣ)
    (hζ : (evalWord relator ρ x) ^ 2 - evalWord relator ρ x + 1 = 0) :
    witnessChain relator ρ witness = 0 := by
  ext i
  fin_cases i
  simpa [witnessChain, witness, factorChain, basis, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm,
    add_left_comm, add_assoc] using hζ

theorem exact_zero_certificate :
    (quotient relator x) ^ 6 = 1 ∧
      character (quotient relator x) ≠ 1 ∧
      witnessWord relator witness = x ^ 6 ∧
      witnessChain relator character witness = 0 := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, word_identity, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [relator, map_pow] using quotient_relator relator (0 : Fin 1)
  · rw [character_generator]
    intro h
    apply zeta_ne_one
    exact congrArg (fun u : ℂˣ => (u : ℂ)) h
  · apply coefficient_zero
    simpa using zeta_quadratic

theorem boundary_not_injective : ¬ Function.Injective (boundary relator character) := by
  intro h
  have hz : fox relator character (x ^ 6) = 0 :=
    torsion_fox_zero relator character exact_zero_certificate.1
      exact_zero_certificate.2.1
  have he : boundary relator character (basis (0 : Fin 1)) =
      boundary relator character 0 := by
    rw [boundary_basis, map_zero]
    exact hz
  have hc := congrFun (h he) (0 : Fin 1)
  norm_num [basis] at hc

end Cancellation

end TorsionFox

namespace FoxTower

open TorsionFox

variable {n m : ℕ} {V : Type}

structure RightAction (n : ℕ) (V : Type) where
  act : Word n → V → V
  one : ∀ v, act 1 v = v
  mul : ∀ u w v, act (u * w) v = act w (act u v)

namespace RightAction

variable (A : RightAction n V)

@[simp] theorem act_one (v : V) : A.act 1 v = v := A.one v

theorem act_mul (u w : Word n) (v : V) :
    A.act (u * w) v = A.act w (A.act u v) := A.mul u w v

@[simp] theorem act_inv_act (w : Word n) (v : V) :
    A.act w⁻¹ (A.act w v) = v := by
  rw [← A.act_mul, mul_inv_cancel, A.act_one]

@[simp] theorem act_act_inv (w : Word n) (v : V) :
    A.act w (A.act w⁻¹ v) = v := by
  rw [← A.act_mul, inv_mul_cancel, A.act_one]

def shiftAction : Word n →* MulAut (Multiplicative (V → ℚ)) where
  toFun w :=
    { toFun := fun f => Multiplicative.ofAdd (fun v => f.toAdd (A.act w v))
      invFun := fun f => Multiplicative.ofAdd (fun v => f.toAdd (A.act w⁻¹ v))
      left_inv := by
        intro f
        change (fun v => f.toAdd (A.act w (A.act w⁻¹ v))) = f.toAdd
        simp
      right_inv := by
        intro f
        change (fun v => f.toAdd (A.act w⁻¹ (A.act w v))) = f.toAdd
        simp
      map_mul' := by intros; rfl }
  map_one' := by
    apply MulEquiv.ext
    intro f
    change (fun v => f.toAdd (A.act 1 v)) = f.toAdd
    simp
  map_mul' := by
    intro u w
    apply MulEquiv.ext
    intro f
    change (fun v => f.toAdd (A.act (u * w) v)) =
      (fun v => f.toAdd (A.act w (A.act u v)))
    simp [A.act_mul]

abbrev VoltageGroup := Multiplicative (V → ℚ) ⋊[A.shiftAction] Word n

def voltagePath (a : V → Fin n → ℚ) : Word n →* A.VoltageGroup :=
  FreeGroup.lift fun i =>
    ⟨Multiplicative.ofAdd (fun v => a v i), FreeGroup.of i⟩

theorem voltagePath_right (a : V → Fin n → ℚ) (w : Word n) :
    (A.voltagePath a w).right = w := by
  have h : (SemidirectProduct.rightHom : A.VoltageGroup →* Word n).comp
      (A.voltagePath a) = MonoidHom.id (Word n) :=
    FreeGroup.ext_hom _ _ (by intro i; simp [voltagePath])
  exact congrArg (fun f : Word n →* Word n => f w) h

def voltage (a : V → Fin n → ℚ) (w : Word n) (v : V) : ℚ :=
  (A.voltagePath a w).left.toAdd v

@[simp] theorem voltage_one (a : V → Fin n → ℚ) (v : V) :
    A.voltage a 1 v = 0 := by simp [voltage]

@[simp] theorem voltage_generator (a : V → Fin n → ℚ) (v : V) (i : Fin n) :
    A.voltage a (FreeGroup.of i) v = a v i := by
  simp [voltage, voltagePath]

theorem voltage_mul (a : V → Fin n → ℚ) (u w : Word n) (v : V) :
    A.voltage a (u * w) v =
      A.voltage a u v + A.voltage a w (A.act u v) := by
  simp [voltage, shiftAction, voltagePath_right]

theorem voltage_inv (a : V → Fin n → ℚ) (w : Word n) (v : V) :
    A.voltage a w⁻¹ v = -A.voltage a w (A.act w⁻¹ v) := by
  simp [voltage, shiftAction, voltagePath_right]

def lift (a : V → Fin n → ℚ) : RightAction n (V × ℚ) where
  act w p := (A.act w p.1, p.2 + A.voltage a w p.1)
  one p := by simp
  mul u w p := by simp [A.act_mul, A.voltage_mul, add_assoc]

theorem lift_act (a : V → Fin n → ℚ) (w : Word n) (p : V × ℚ) :
    (A.lift a).act w p = (A.act w p.1, p.2 + A.voltage a w p.1) := rfl

@[simp] theorem lift_fst (a : V → Fin n → ℚ) (w : Word n) (p : V × ℚ) :
    ((A.lift a).act w p).1 = A.act w p.1 := rfl

@[simp] theorem lift_snd (a : V → Fin n → ℚ) (w : Word n) (p : V × ℚ) :
    ((A.lift a).act w p).2 = p.2 + A.voltage a w p.1 := rfl

theorem voltage_pow_of_fixed (a : V → Fin n → ℚ) (w : Word n) (v : V)
    (hw : A.act w v = v) (q : ℕ) :
    A.voltage a (w ^ q) v = (q : ℚ) * A.voltage a w v := by
  induction q with
  | zero => simp
  | succ q ih =>
      rw [pow_succ', A.voltage_mul, hw, ih]
      push_cast
      ring

theorem inv_fixed {w : Word n} {v : V} (h : A.act w v = v) :
    A.act w⁻¹ v = v := by
  simpa only [h] using A.act_inv_act w v

theorem conjugate_fixed (u w : Word n) (v : V)
    (h : A.act w (A.act u v) = A.act u v) :
    A.act (u * w * u⁻¹) v = v := by
  rw [A.act_mul, A.act_mul, h, A.act_inv_act]

theorem prod_fixed (ws : List (Word n)) (v : V)
    (h : ∀ w ∈ ws, A.act w v = v) :
    A.act ws.prod v = v := by
  induction ws with
  | nil => simp
  | cons w ws ih =>
      rw [List.prod_cons, A.act_mul, h w (by simp)]
      exact ih (by intro z hz; exact h z (by simp [hz]))

theorem lift_relator_fixed (a : V → Fin n → ℚ) (u r : Word n) (v : V)
    (hr : A.act r (A.act u v) = A.act u v)
    (ha : A.voltage a r (A.act u v) = 0) :
    (A.lift a).act r ((A.lift a).act u (v, 0)) =
      (A.lift a).act u (v, 0) := by
  ext <;> simp [hr, ha]

theorem lift_factor_fixed (a : V → Fin n → ℚ) (r : Fin m → Word n)
    (v : V) (f : Factor n m)
    (hr : A.act (r f.index) (A.act f.conjugator v) = A.act f.conjugator v)
    (ha : A.voltage a (r f.index) (A.act f.conjugator v) = 0) :
    (A.lift a).act (factorWord r f) (v, 0) = (v, 0) := by
  apply (A.lift a).conjugate_fixed
  have h := A.lift_relator_fixed a f.conjugator (r f.index) v hr ha
  cases hp : f.positive
  · exact (A.lift a).inv_fixed h
  · exact h

theorem lift_witness_fixed (a : V → Fin n → ℚ) (r : Fin m → Word n)
    (v : V) (fs : List (Factor n m))
    (hr : ∀ f ∈ fs, A.act (r f.index) (A.act f.conjugator v) = A.act f.conjugator v)
    (ha : ∀ f ∈ fs, A.voltage a (r f.index) (A.act f.conjugator v) = 0) :
    (A.lift a).act (witnessWord r fs) (v, 0) = (v, 0) := by
  induction fs with
  | nil => simp [witnessWord]
  | cons f fs ih =>
      rw [witnessWord, (A.lift a).act_mul,
        A.lift_factor_fixed a r v f (hr f (by simp)) (ha f (by simp))]
      exact ih (by intro z hz; exact hr z (by simp [hz]))
        (by intro z hz; exact ha z (by simp [hz]))

theorem torsion_voltage_zero (a : V → Fin n → ℚ) (r : Fin m → Word n)
    (v : V) (w : Word n) (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hw : A.act w v = v) (fs : List (Factor n m))
    (hfs : witnessWord r fs = w ^ q)
    (hr : ∀ f ∈ fs, A.act (r f.index) (A.act f.conjugator v) = A.act f.conjugator v)
    (ha : ∀ f ∈ fs, A.voltage a (r f.index) (A.act f.conjugator v) = 0) :
    A.voltage a w v = 0 := by
  have h := congrArg Prod.snd (A.lift_witness_fixed a r v fs hr ha)
  simp only [lift_snd, zero_add, hfs, A.voltage_pow_of_fixed a w v hw q] at h
  exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h).resolve_left (by exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt hq))

theorem torsion_lifts (a : V → Fin n → ℚ) (r : Fin m → Word n)
    (v : V) (w : Word n) (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hw : A.act w v = v) (fs : List (Factor n m))
    (hfs : witnessWord r fs = w ^ q)
    (hr : ∀ f ∈ fs, A.act (r f.index) (A.act f.conjugator v) = A.act f.conjugator v)
    (ha : ∀ f ∈ fs, A.voltage a (r f.index) (A.act f.conjugator v) = 0) :
    (A.lift a).act w (v, 0) = (v, 0) := by
  ext
  · exact hw
  · simpa using A.torsion_voltage_zero a r v w q hq hw fs hfs hr ha

end RightAction

abbrev Letter (n : ℕ) := Fin n × Bool

def letterWord (l : Letter n) : Word n :=
  cond l.2 (FreeGroup.of l.1) (FreeGroup.of l.1)⁻¹

def lettersWord (ls : List (Letter n)) : Word n :=
  (ls.map letterWord).prod

theorem lettersWord_toWord (w : Word n) : lettersWord w.toWord = w := by
  have hi : FreeGroup.lift (fun i : Fin n => FreeGroup.of i) =
      MonoidHom.id (Word n) :=
    FreeGroup.ext_hom _ _ (by intro i; simp)
  have h := FreeGroup.lift_mk (f := fun i : Fin n => FreeGroup.of i) (L := w.toWord)
  rw [hi, MonoidHom.id_apply, FreeGroup.mk_toWord] at h
  exact h.symm

def walkEdges (A : RightAction n V) : V → List (Letter n) → List (V × Fin n)
  | _, [] => []
  | v, l :: ls =>
      (cond l.2 (v, l.1) (A.act (FreeGroup.of l.1)⁻¹ v, l.1)) ::
        walkEdges A (A.act (letterWord l) v) ls

theorem walkEdges_length (A : RightAction n V) (ls : List (Letter n)) (v : V) :
    (walkEdges A v ls).length = ls.length := by
  induction ls generalizing v with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons l ls ih => simp [walkEdges, ih]

theorem walkEdges_natural {W : Type} (A : RightAction n V) (B : RightAction n W)
    (f : W → V) (hf : ∀ w v, f (B.act w v) = A.act w (f v))
    (ls : List (Letter n)) (v : W) :
    (walkEdges B v ls).map (fun e => (f e.1, e.2)) = walkEdges A (f v) ls := by
  induction ls generalizing v with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons l ls ih =>
      cases hb : l.2 <;> simp [walkEdges, letterWord, hb, ih, hf]

def sourcePaths (r : Fin m → Word n) (w : Word n) (fs : List (Factor n m)) :
    List (Word n × List (Letter n)) :=
  (1, w.toWord) :: fs.flatMap (fun f =>
    [(1, f.conjugator.toWord), (f.conjugator, (r f.index).toWord)])

def sourceEdges (A : RightAction n V) (v : V)
    (ps : List (Word n × List (Letter n))) : List (V × Fin n) :=
  ps.flatMap fun p => walkEdges A (A.act p.1 v) p.2

def sourceVertices (A : RightAction n V) (v : V)
    (ps : List (Word n × List (Letter n))) : List V :=
  v :: (sourceEdges A v ps).flatMap (fun e => [e.1, A.act (FreeGroup.of e.2) e.1])

noncomputable def vertexSet (A : RightAction n V) (v : V)
    (ps : List (Word n × List (Letter n))) : Finset V := by
  classical
  exact (sourceVertices A v ps).toFinset

def sourceBudget (ps : List (Word n × List (Letter n))) : ℕ :=
  1 + 2 * (ps.map (fun p => p.2.length)).sum

theorem sourceEdges_length (A : RightAction n V) (v : V)
    (ps : List (Word n × List (Letter n))) :
    (sourceEdges A v ps).length = (ps.map (fun p => p.2.length)).sum := by
  simp [sourceEdges, List.length_flatMap, walkEdges_length]

theorem sourceVertices_length (A : RightAction n V) (v : V)
    (ps : List (Word n × List (Letter n))) :
    (sourceVertices A v ps).length = sourceBudget ps := by
  have h : ∀ es : List (V × Fin n),
      (es.flatMap (fun e => [e.1, A.act (FreeGroup.of e.2) e.1])).length =
        2 * es.length := by
    intro es
    induction es with
    | nil => simp
    | cons e es ih => simp [ih]; omega
  simp only [sourceVertices, List.length_cons, h, sourceEdges_length, sourceBudget]
  omega

theorem vertexSet_bound (A : RightAction n V) (v : V)
    (ps : List (Word n × List (Letter n))) :
    (vertexSet A v ps).card ≤ sourceBudget ps := by
  classical
  simpa only [vertexSet, sourceVertices_length] using
    (List.toFinset_card_le (sourceVertices A v ps))

theorem sourceEdges_natural {W : Type} (A : RightAction n V) (B : RightAction n W)
    (f : W → V) (hf : ∀ w v, f (B.act w v) = A.act w (f v))
    (ps : List (Word n × List (Letter n))) (v : W) :
    (sourceEdges B v ps).map (fun e => (f e.1, e.2)) = sourceEdges A (f v) ps := by
  simp only [sourceEdges, List.map_flatMap]
  congr 1
  funext p
  rw [walkEdges_natural A B f hf, hf]

theorem sourceVertices_natural {W : Type} (A : RightAction n V) (B : RightAction n W)
    (f : W → V) (hf : ∀ w v, f (B.act w v) = A.act w (f v))
    (ps : List (Word n × List (Letter n))) (v : W) :
    (sourceVertices B v ps).map f = sourceVertices A (f v) ps := by
  simp only [sourceVertices, List.map_cons, List.map_flatMap]
  rw [← sourceEdges_natural A B f hf ps v, List.flatMap_map]
  congr 2
  funext e
  simp [hf]

theorem vertexSet_natural {W : Type} [DecidableEq V]
    (A : RightAction n V) (B : RightAction n W)
    (f : W → V) (hf : ∀ w v, f (B.act w v) = A.act w (f v))
    (ps : List (Word n × List (Letter n))) (v : W) :
    (vertexSet B v ps).image f = vertexSet A (f v) ps := by
  classical
  ext x
  simp only [vertexSet, Finset.mem_image, List.mem_toFinset]
  rw [← sourceVertices_natural A B f hf ps v]
  exact List.mem_map.symm

theorem edge_source_mem (A : RightAction n V) (v : V)
    (ps : List (Word n × List (Letter n))) (e : V × Fin n)
    (he : e ∈ sourceEdges A v ps) : e.1 ∈ vertexSet A v ps := by
  classical
  simp only [vertexSet, List.mem_toFinset, sourceVertices, List.mem_cons]
  right
  exact List.mem_flatMap.mpr ⟨e, he, by simp⟩

theorem edge_target_mem (A : RightAction n V) (v : V)
    (ps : List (Word n × List (Letter n))) (e : V × Fin n)
    (he : e ∈ sourceEdges A v ps) :
    A.act (FreeGroup.of e.2) e.1 ∈ vertexSet A v ps := by
  classical
  simp only [vertexSet, List.mem_toFinset, sourceVertices, List.mem_cons]
  right
  exact List.mem_flatMap.mpr ⟨e, he, by simp⟩

def IsGradient (A : RightAction n V) (v : V)
    (ps : List (Word n × List (Letter n))) (a : V → Fin n → ℚ) : Prop :=
  ∃ b : V → ℚ, ∀ e ∈ sourceEdges A v ps,
    a e.1 e.2 = b (A.act (FreeGroup.of e.2) e.1) - b e.1

theorem equal_count_implies_gradient (A : RightAction n V) (v : V)
    (ps : List (Word n × List (Letter n))) (a : V → Fin n → ℚ)
    (hc : (vertexSet (A.lift a) (v, 0) ps).card = (vertexSet A v ps).card) :
    IsGradient A v ps a := by
  classical
  let S := vertexSet (A.lift a) (v, 0) ps
  have hp : S.image Prod.fst = vertexSet A v ps :=
    vertexSet_natural A (A.lift a) Prod.fst (by intros; rfl) ps (v, 0)
  have hinj : Set.InjOn Prod.fst (S : Set (V × ℚ)) := by
    apply Finset.card_image_iff.mp
    rw [hp]
    exact hc.symm
  let b : V → ℚ := fun x =>
    if h : ∃ t : ℚ, (x, t) ∈ S then Classical.choose h else 0
  have hb : ∀ x t, (x, t) ∈ S → b x = t := by
    intro x t ht
    have hex : ∃ s : ℚ, (x, s) ∈ S := ⟨t, ht⟩
    change (if h : ∃ s : ℚ, (x, s) ∈ S then Classical.choose h else 0) = t
    rw [dif_pos hex]
    exact congrArg Prod.snd
      (hinj (Classical.choose_spec hex) ht rfl)
  refine ⟨b, ?_⟩
  intro e he
  have he' : e ∈ (sourceEdges (A.lift a) (v, 0) ps).map
      (fun z => (z.1.1, z.2)) := by
    rw [sourceEdges_natural A (A.lift a) Prod.fst (by intros; rfl)]
    exact he
  obtain ⟨d, hd, hde⟩ := List.mem_map.mp he'
  subst e
  have hs := edge_source_mem (A.lift a) (v, 0) ps d hd
  have ht := edge_target_mem (A.lift a) (v, 0) ps d hd
  have hbs : b d.1.1 = d.1.2 := hb _ _ hs
  have hbt : b (A.act (FreeGroup.of d.2) d.1.1) = d.1.2 + a d.1.1 d.2 := by
    simpa only [RightAction.lift_fst, RightAction.lift_snd,
      RightAction.voltage_generator] using hb _ _ ht
  dsimp
  rw [hbt, hbs]
  ring

theorem voltage_strict_growth (A : RightAction n V) (v : V)
    (ps : List (Word n × List (Letter n))) (a : V → Fin n → ℚ)
    (ha : ¬ IsGradient A v ps a) :
    (vertexSet A v ps).card < (vertexSet (A.lift a) (v, 0) ps).card := by
  classical
  have hp := vertexSet_natural A (A.lift a) Prod.fst (by intros; rfl) ps (v, 0)
  have hle : (vertexSet A v ps).card ≤ (vertexSet (A.lift a) (v, 0) ps).card := by
    rw [← hp]
    exact Finset.card_image_le
  refine lt_of_le_of_ne hle ?_
  intro heq
  exact ha (equal_count_implies_gradient A v ps a heq.symm)

theorem square_mulVec_injective_of_det_ne_zero {R J : Type}
    [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J]
    (B : Matrix J J R) (hB : B.det ≠ 0) : Function.Injective B.mulVec := by
  intro x y h
  have ha := congrArg B.adjugate.mulVec h
  rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.adjugate_mul] at ha
  simp only [Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec] at ha
  funext j
  exact mul_left_cancel₀ hB (congrFun ha j)

theorem specialization_injective {R I J : Type}
    [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq J]
    (ε : R →+* ℂ) (ι : ℂ →+* R) (hει : ∀ z, ε (ι z) = z)
    (B : Matrix I J R) (hB : Function.Injective (B.map ε).mulVec) :
    Function.Injective B.mulVec := by
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := LinearMap.exists_leftInverse_of_injective
    (Matrix.toLin' (B.map ε)) (LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mpr hB)
  let L : Matrix J I ℂ := LinearMap.toMatrix' g
  have hL : L * B.map ε = 1 := by
    have h := congrArg LinearMap.toMatrix' hg
    simpa [LinearMap.toMatrix'_comp, L] using h
  let C : Matrix J J R := L.map ι * B
  have hC : C.map ε = 1 := by
    ext i j
    have h := congrArg (fun M : Matrix J J ℂ => M i j) hL
    simpa [C, Matrix.mul_apply, hει] using h
  have hdet : C.det ≠ 0 := by
    have h : ε C.det = 1 := by
      rw [RingHom.map_det]
      change (C.map ε).det = 1
      rw [hC, Matrix.det_one]
    intro hz
    rw [hz, map_zero] at h
    exact zero_ne_one h
  intro x y h
  apply square_mulVec_injective_of_det_ne_zero C hdet
  change (L.map ι * B).mulVec x = (L.map ι * B).mulVec y
  rw [← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, h]

namespace RightAction

variable (A : RightAction n V)

theorem voltage_add (a b : V → Fin n → ℚ) (w : Word n) (v : V) :
    A.voltage (a + b) w v = A.voltage a w v + A.voltage b w v := by
  have h : ∀ v, A.voltage (a + b) w v = A.voltage a w v + A.voltage b w v := by
    refine FreeGroup.induction_on w ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · intro v; simp
    · intro i v; simp
    · intro i hi v
      simp only [A.voltage_inv, hi]
      ring
    · intro u z hu hz v
      simp only [A.voltage_mul, hu, hz]
      ring
  exact h v

theorem voltage_smul (c : ℚ) (a : V → Fin n → ℚ) (w : Word n) (v : V) :
    A.voltage (c • a) w v = c * A.voltage a w v := by
  have h : ∀ v, A.voltage (c • a) w v = c * A.voltage a w v := by
    refine FreeGroup.induction_on w ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · intro v; simp
    · intro i v; simp
    · intro i hi v
      simp [A.voltage_inv, hi]
    · intro u z hu hz v
      simp only [A.voltage_mul, hu, hz]
      ring
  exact h v

def voltageLinear (w : Word n) (v : V) : (V → Fin n → ℚ) →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ where
  toFun a := A.voltage a w v
  map_add' a b := A.voltage_add a b w v
  map_smul' c a := A.voltage_smul c a w v

section Weighted

variable {K : Type} [CommRing K] (κ : Word n →* Kˣ)

abbrev EdgeChain := (V × Fin n) →₀ K
abbrev VertexChain := V →₀ K

def chainAction : Word n →* MulAut (Multiplicative (V → EdgeChain (n := n) (V := V) (K := K))) where
  toFun w :=
    { toFun := fun f => Multiplicative.ofAdd
        (fun v => (κ w : K) • f.toAdd (A.act w v))
      invFun := fun f => Multiplicative.ofAdd
        (fun v => (κ w⁻¹ : K) • f.toAdd (A.act w⁻¹ v))
      left_inv := by
        intro f
        change (fun v => (κ w⁻¹ : K) •
          ((κ w : K) • f.toAdd (A.act w (A.act w⁻¹ v)))) = f.toAdd
        simp [smul_smul, ← Units.val_mul]
      right_inv := by
        intro f
        change (fun v => (κ w : K) •
          ((κ w⁻¹ : K) • f.toAdd (A.act w⁻¹ (A.act w v)))) = f.toAdd
        simp [smul_smul, ← Units.val_mul]
      map_mul' := by
        intro f g
        change (fun v => (κ w : K) • (f.toAdd (A.act w v) + g.toAdd (A.act w v))) =
          (fun v => (κ w : K) • f.toAdd (A.act w v) + (κ w : K) • g.toAdd (A.act w v))
        simp [smul_add] }
  map_one' := by
    apply MulEquiv.ext
    intro f
    change (fun v => (κ 1 : K) • f.toAdd (A.act 1 v)) = f.toAdd
    simp
  map_mul' := by
    intro u w
    apply MulEquiv.ext
    intro f
    change (fun v => (κ (u * w) : K) • f.toAdd (A.act (u * w) v)) =
      (fun v => (κ u : K) • ((κ w : K) • f.toAdd (A.act w (A.act u v))))
    simp [A.act_mul, smul_smul]

abbrev ChainPathGroup :=
  Multiplicative (V → EdgeChain (n := n) (V := V) (K := K)) ⋊[A.chainAction κ] Word n

def chainPath : Word n →* A.ChainPathGroup κ :=
  FreeGroup.lift fun i =>
    ⟨Multiplicative.ofAdd (fun v => Finsupp.single (v, i) 1), FreeGroup.of i⟩

theorem chainPath_right (w : Word n) : (A.chainPath κ w).right = w := by
  have h : (SemidirectProduct.rightHom : A.ChainPathGroup κ →* Word n).comp
      (A.chainPath κ) = MonoidHom.id (Word n) :=
    FreeGroup.ext_hom _ _ (by intro i; simp [chainPath])
  exact congrArg (fun f : Word n →* Word n => f w) h

def chain (w : Word n) (v : V) : EdgeChain (n := n) (V := V) (K := K) :=
  (A.chainPath κ w).left.toAdd v

@[simp] theorem chain_one (v : V) : A.chain κ 1 v = 0 := by
  simp [chain]

@[simp] theorem chain_generator (v : V) (i : Fin n) :
    A.chain κ (FreeGroup.of i) v = Finsupp.single (v, i) 1 := by
  simp [chain, chainPath]

theorem chain_mul (u w : Word n) (v : V) :
    A.chain κ (u * w) v =
      A.chain κ u v + (κ u : K) • A.chain κ w (A.act u v) := by
  simp [chain, chainAction, chainPath_right]

theorem chain_inv (w : Word n) (v : V) :
    A.chain κ w⁻¹ v = -((κ w⁻¹ : K) • A.chain κ w (A.act w⁻¹ v)) := by
  simp [chain, chainAction, chainPath_right]

theorem chain_zero_off_walk (ls : List (Letter n)) (v : V) (e : V × Fin n)
    (he : e ∉ walkEdges A v ls) : A.chain κ (lettersWord ls) v e = 0 := by
  classical
  induction ls generalizing v with
  | nil => simp [lettersWord]
  | cons l ls ih =>
      have hfirst : e ≠ cond l.2 (v, l.1) (A.act (FreeGroup.of l.1)⁻¹ v, l.1) :=
        fun h => he (by simp [walkEdges, h])
      have hrest : e ∉ walkEdges A (A.act (letterWord l) v) ls :=
        fun h => he (by simp [walkEdges, h])
      have ht := ih (A.act (letterWord l) v) hrest
      simp only [lettersWord, List.map_cons, List.prod_cons, A.chain_mul,
        Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at *
      rw [ht, mul_zero, add_zero]
      cases hb : l.2 <;>
        simp only [hb, cond_false, cond_true] at hfirst <;>
        simp [letterWord, hb, A.chain_inv, hfirst]

def edgeBoundary : EdgeChain (n := n) (V := V) (K := K) →ₗ[K] VertexChain (V := V) (K := K) :=
  Finsupp.linearCombination K fun e =>
    (κ (FreeGroup.of e.2) : K) • Finsupp.single (A.act (FreeGroup.of e.2) e.1) 1 -
      Finsupp.single e.1 1

theorem edgeBoundary_generator (v : V) (i : Fin n) :
    A.edgeBoundary κ (Finsupp.single (v, i) 1) =
      (κ (FreeGroup.of i) : K) • Finsupp.single (A.act (FreeGroup.of i) v) 1 -
        Finsupp.single v 1 := by
  simp [edgeBoundary]

theorem chain_fundamental (w : Word n) (v : V) :
    A.edgeBoundary κ (A.chain κ w v) =
      (κ w : K) • Finsupp.single (A.act w v) 1 - Finsupp.single v 1 := by
  have h : ∀ v, A.edgeBoundary κ (A.chain κ w v) =
      (κ w : K) • Finsupp.single (A.act w v) 1 - Finsupp.single v 1 := by
    refine FreeGroup.induction_on w ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · intro v; simp
    · intro i v; simp [A.edgeBoundary_generator]
    · intro i hi v
      rw [A.chain_inv, map_neg, map_smul, hi]
      simp only [A.act_act_inv, smul_sub, smul_smul]
      have hc : (κ (FreeGroup.of i)⁻¹ : K) * (κ (FreeGroup.of i) : K) = 1 := by
        rw [← Units.val_mul, ← map_mul, inv_mul_cancel, map_one, Units.val_one]
      rw [hc, one_smul]
      abel
    · intro u z hu hz v
      rw [A.chain_mul, map_add, map_smul, hu, hz]
      simp only [map_mul, Units.val_mul, A.act_mul, smul_sub, smul_smul]
      abel
  exact h v

end Weighted

end RightAction

structure Weights {K : Type} [CommRing K] (A : RightAction n V) where
  val : Word n → V → Kˣ
  one : ∀ v, val 1 v = 1
  mul : ∀ u w v, val (u * w) v = val u v * val w (A.act u v)

namespace Weights

variable {K : Type} [CommRing K] {A : RightAction n V} (L : Weights (K := K) A)

@[simp] theorem val_one (v : V) : L.val 1 v = 1 := L.one v
